<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles scroll-snap navigation, keyboard,
       touch, progress bar, and nav dots.
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
        }

        /* Build nav dots from slide count */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* Intersection observer triggers .visible + updates progress */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.updateUI(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        updateUI(idx) {
            this.currentIndex = idx;
            /* Progress bar */
            const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            /* Nav dots */
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* Keyboard: arrow keys, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                const map = {
                    'ArrowDown': 1, 'ArrowRight': 1, ' ': 1, 'PageDown': 1,
                    'ArrowUp': -1, 'ArrowLeft': -1, 'PageUp': -1,
                };
                if (e.key in map) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + map[e.key]);
                } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0);
                } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.totalSlides - 1);
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch/swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (delta > 0 ? 1 : -1));
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel — debounced to prevent rapid firing */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let timeout = null;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (timeout) return;
                this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                timeout = setTimeout(() => { timeout = null; }, 700);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
        document.querySelector('.slide').classList.add('visible');
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

            --bar-2: #52b788;   /* anxiety */
            --bar-3: #f4a261;   /* schizophrenia */
            --bar-4: #e76f51;   /* bipolar */
            --bar-5: #9b72cf;   /* eating */

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.65s;

            /* Spacing (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.9rem);

            /* Typography (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --title-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.78rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 0.9vw, 0.82rem);
            --callout-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 6rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.85vw, 0.78rem);
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS — MANDATORY RESPONSIVE STYLES
           Ensures every slide fits exactly 100vh.
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
                --callout-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* === END VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS === */

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND TEXTURE — subtle dot grid
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 32px 32px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE INNER LAYOUT HELPERS
           =========================================== */
        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* Accent top-bar present on all content slides */
        .slide-topbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .slide-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        /* Accent horizontal rule */
        .accent-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — staggered reveal on .visible
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(22px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.62s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.88);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #52b788);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 7px; height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.5);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 15%, rgba(82, 183, 136, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .title-slide .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-bottom: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        }
        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .title-main .title-highlight {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 300;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 600px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .title-meta-item {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .title-meta-item strong {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        /* Large decorative teal line — top right corner accent */
        .title-slide .deco-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; right: 0;
            width: clamp(200px, 35vw, 500px);
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent));
        }
        .title-slide .deco-circle {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(-80px, -10vh, -40px);
            right: clamp(-80px, -10vw, -40px);
            width: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            height: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .title-slide .deco-circle-2 {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(-40px, -5vh, -20px);
            right: clamp(-40px, -5vw, -20px);
            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            height: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.2);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — SCALE / PREVALENCE (callout numbers)
           =========================================== */
        .prevalence-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }
        .callout-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .callout-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }
        .callout-card.women::before { background: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men::before { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--callout-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .callout-card.women .callout-number { color: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men .callout-number { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .callout-label strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .context-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .context-block strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDES 3–5 — BAR CHART & COMPARISONS
           =========================================== */
        .chart-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 780px);
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            width: clamp(100px, 18vw, 185px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3.5vh, 38px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill::after {
            content: attr(data-value);
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(6px, 1vw, 10px);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .slide.visible .bar-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        /* Chart legend */
        .chart-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — PARITY (side-by-side paired bars)
           =========================================== */
        .parity-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .parity-bar-group {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .parity-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .parity-daly-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .parity-bar-visual {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
            transition: height 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
            height: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .parity-bar-visual { height: var(--bar-h); }
        .parity-disorder-name {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .parity-insight {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule-accent);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
        }
        .parity-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — SEVERE CONDITIONS
           =========================================== */
        .severe-comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .severe-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .severe-card.reference {
            border-color: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.15);
            background: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.05);
        }
        .severe-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .severe-daly {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .severe-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .severe-ratio-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: auto;
        }
        .severe-ratio-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .severe-ratio-fill { width: var(--ratio-w); }
        .severe-footnote {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — TREATMENT GAP (icon + text)
           =========================================== */
        .gap-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .gap-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .gap-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .gap-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3em; }
        .gap-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .gap-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .gap-header-row {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.15), rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.1));
            border: 1px solid rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .gap-header-row strong { color: var(--accent-warm); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — COPING STRATEGIES
           =========================================== */
        .coping-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .coping-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .coping-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .coping-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .coping-detail {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .coping-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .coping-insight {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule-accent);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .coping-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8 — TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 820px);
            list-style: none;
        }
        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
        }
        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 500;
            flex-shrink: 0;

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles scroll-snap navigation, keyboard,
       touch, progress bar, and nav dots.
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
        }

        /* Build nav dots from slide count */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* Intersection observer triggers .visible + updates progress */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.updateUI(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        updateUI(idx) {
            this.currentIndex = idx;
            /* Progress bar */
            const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            /* Nav dots */
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* Keyboard: arrow keys, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                const map = {
                    'ArrowDown': 1, 'ArrowRight': 1, ' ': 1, 'PageDown': 1,
                    'ArrowUp': -1, 'ArrowLeft': -1, 'PageUp': -1,
                };
                if (e.key in map) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + map[e.key]);
                } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0);
                } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.totalSlides - 1);
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch/swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (delta > 0 ? 1 : -1));
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel — debounced to prevent rapid firing */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let timeout = null;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (timeout) return;
                this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                timeout = setTimeout(() => { timeout = null; }, 700);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
        document.querySelector('.slide').classList.add('visible');
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

            --text-muted: #4f6e8a;
            --accent: #1ecbe1;
            --accent-dim: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.18);
            --accent-glow: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.35);
            --accent-warm: #f4a261;
            --accent-warn: #e76f51;
            --accent-green: #52b788;
            --rule: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            --rule-accent: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.3);

            /* Data color scale for charts */
            --bar-1: #1ecbe1;   /* depressive */
            --bar-2: #52b788;   /* anxiety */
            --bar-3: #f4a261;   /* schizophrenia */
            --bar-4: #e76f51;   /* bipolar */
            --bar-5: #9b72cf;   /* eating */

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.65s;

            /* Spacing (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.9rem);

            /* Typography (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --title-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.78rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 0.9vw, 0.82rem);
            --callout-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 6rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.85vw, 0.78rem);
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS — MANDATORY RESPONSIVE STYLES
           Ensures every slide fits exactly 100vh.
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
                --callout-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* === END VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS === */

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND TEXTURE — subtle dot grid
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 32px 32px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE INNER LAYOUT HELPERS
           =========================================== */
        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* Accent top-bar present on all content slides */
        .slide-topbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .slide-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        /* Accent horizontal rule */
        .accent-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — staggered reveal on .visible
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(22px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.62s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.88);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #52b788);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 7px; height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.5);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 15%, rgba(82, 183, 136, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .title-slide .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-bottom: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        }
        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .title-main .title-highlight {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 300;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 600px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .title-meta-item {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .title-meta-item strong {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        /* Large decorative teal line — top right corner accent */
        .title-slide .deco-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; right: 0;
            width: clamp(200px, 35vw, 500px);
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent));
        }
        .title-slide .deco-circle {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(-80px, -10vh, -40px);
            right: clamp(-80px, -10vw, -40px);
            width: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            height: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .title-slide .deco-circle-2 {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(-40px, -5vh, -20px);
            right: clamp(-40px, -5vw, -20px);
            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            height: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.2);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — SCALE / PREVALENCE (callout numbers)
           =========================================== */
        .prevalence-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }
        .callout-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .callout-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }
        .callout-card.women::before { background: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men::before { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--callout-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .callout-card.women .callout-number { color: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men .callout-number { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .callout-label strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .context-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .context-block strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDES 3–5 — BAR CHART & COMPARISONS
           =========================================== */
        .chart-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 780px);
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            width: clamp(100px, 18vw, 185px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3.5vh, 38px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill::after {
            content: attr(data-value);
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(6px, 1vw, 10px);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .slide.visible .bar-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        /* Chart legend */
        .chart-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — PARITY (side-by-side paired bars)
           =========================================== */
        .parity-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .parity-bar-group {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .parity-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .parity-daly-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .parity-bar-visual {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
            transition: height 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
            height: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .parity-bar-visual { height: var(--bar-h); }
        .parity-disorder-name {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .parity-insight {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule-accent);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
        }
        .parity-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — SEVERE CONDITIONS
           =========================================== */
        .severe-comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .severe-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .severe-card.reference {
            border-color: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.15);
            background: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.05);
        }
        .severe-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .severe-daly {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .severe-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .severe-ratio-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: auto;
        }
        .severe-ratio-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .severe-ratio-fill { width: var(--ratio-w); }
        .severe-footnote {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — TREATMENT GAP (icon + text)
           =========================================== */
        .gap-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .gap-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .gap-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .gap-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3em; }
        .gap-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .gap-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .gap-header-row {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.15), rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.1));
            border: 1px solid rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .gap-header-row strong { color: var(--accent-warm); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — COPING STRATEGIES
           =========================================== */
        .coping-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .coping-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .coping-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .coping-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .coping-detail {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .coping-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .coping-insight {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule-accent);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .coping-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8 — TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 820px);
            list-style: none;
        }
        .takeaway-item {

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles scroll-snap navigation, keyboard,
       touch, progress bar, and nav dots.
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
        }

        /* Build nav dots from slide count */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* Intersection observer triggers .visible + updates progress */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.updateUI(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        updateUI(idx) {
            this.currentIndex = idx;
            /* Progress bar */
            const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            /* Nav dots */
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* Keyboard: arrow keys, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                const map = {
                    'ArrowDown': 1, 'ArrowRight': 1, ' ': 1, 'PageDown': 1,
                    'ArrowUp': -1, 'ArrowLeft': -1, 'PageUp': -1,
                };
                if (e.key in map) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + map[e.key]);
                } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0);
                } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.totalSlides - 1);
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch/swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (delta > 0 ? 1 : -1));
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel — debounced to prevent rapid firing */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let timeout = null;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (timeout) return;
                this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                timeout = setTimeout(() => { timeout = null; }, 700);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Mark first slide visible immediately */
        document.querySelector('.slide').classList.add('visible');
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           THEME: DATA HEALTH — Swiss Modern adapted for
           public health policy. Navy authority + teal accent.
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            /* Core palette */
            --bg-primary: #0d1b2a;
            --bg-secondary: #112236;
            --bg-card: #162840;
            --text-primary: #f0f4f8;
            --text-secondary: #8fa8c0;

            --accent-dim: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.18);
            --accent-glow: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.35);
            --accent-warm: #f4a261;
            --accent-warn: #e76f51;
            --accent-green: #52b788;
            --rule: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            --rule-accent: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.3);

            /* Data color scale for charts */
            --bar-1: #1ecbe1;   /* depressive */
            --bar-2: #52b788;   /* anxiety */
            --bar-3: #f4a261;   /* schizophrenia */
            --bar-4: #e76f51;   /* bipolar */
            --bar-5: #9b72cf;   /* eating */

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.65s;

            /* Spacing (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.9rem);

            /* Typography (clamp — viewport-responsive) */
            --title-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.78rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 0.9vw, 0.82rem);
            --callout-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 6rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.85vw, 0.78rem);
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS — MANDATORY RESPONSIVE STYLES
           Ensures every slide fits exactly 100vh.
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
                --callout-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* === END VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS === */

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUND TEXTURE — subtle dot grid
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 32px 32px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE INNER LAYOUT HELPERS
           =========================================== */
        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* Accent top-bar present on all content slides */
        .slide-topbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .slide-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        /* Accent horizontal rule */
        .accent-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — staggered reveal on .visible
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(22px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.62s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.88);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #52b788);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 7px; height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.5);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 15%, rgba(82, 183, 136, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .title-slide .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-bottom: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        }
        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .title-main .title-highlight {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 300;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 600px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);

        .title-meta-item {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .title-meta-item strong {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        /* Large decorative teal line — top right corner accent */
        .title-slide .deco-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; right: 0;
            width: clamp(200px, 35vw, 500px);
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent));
        }
        .title-slide .deco-circle {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(-80px, -10vh, -40px);
            right: clamp(-80px, -10vw, -40px);
            width: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            height: clamp(200px, 30vw, 400px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.12);
            pointer-events: none;

        .title-slide .deco-circle-2 {
            position: absolute;

            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            height: clamp(120px, 18vw, 240px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.2);
            pointer-events: none;

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — SCALE / PREVALENCE (callout numbers)

        .prevalence-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

        .callout-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);

            overflow: hidden;
