        .callout-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }
        .callout-card.women::before { background: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men::before { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--callout-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .callout-card.women .callout-number { color: var(--accent); }
        .callout-card.men .callout-number { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .callout-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .callout-label strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .context-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .context-block strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDES 3–5 — BAR CHART & COMPARISONS
           =========================================== */
        .chart-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 780px);
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            width: clamp(100px, 18vw, 185px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3.5vh, 38px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill::after {
            content: attr(data-value);
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(6px, 1vw, 10px);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .slide.visible .bar-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        /* Chart legend */
        .chart-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — PARITY (side-by-side paired bars)
           =========================================== */
        .parity-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
            align-items: flex-end;
        }
        .parity-bar-group {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .parity-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }
        .parity-daly-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .parity-bar-visual {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
            transition: height 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
            height: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .parity-bar-visual { height: var(--bar-h); }
        .parity-disorder-name {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .parity-insight {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule-accent);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 800px);
        }
        .parity-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — SEVERE CONDITIONS
           =========================================== */
        .severe-comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .severe-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.6rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .severe-card.reference {
            border-color: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.15);
            background: rgba(30, 203, 225, 0.05);
        }
        .severe-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .severe-daly {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .severe-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .severe-ratio-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: auto;
        }
        .severe-ratio-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .severe-ratio-fill { width: var(--ratio-w); }
        .severe-footnote {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — TREATMENT GAP (icon + text)
           =========================================== */
        .gap-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .gap-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .gap-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .gap-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3em; }
        .gap-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .gap-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .gap-header-row {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.15), rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.1));
            border: 1px solid rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .gap-header-row strong { color: var(--accent-warm); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — COPING STRATEGIES
           =========================================== */
        .coping-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(90vw, 860px);
        }
        .coping-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }
        .coping-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .coping-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .coping-detail {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .coping-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .coping-insight {

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles scroll-snap navigation, keyboard,
       touch, progress bar, and nav dots.
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
        }

        /* Build nav dots from slide count */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* Intersection observer triggers .visible + updates progress */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.updateUI(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        updateUI(idx) {
            this.currentIndex = idx;
            /* Progress bar */
            const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            /* Nav dots */
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.totalSlides) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* Keyboard: arrow keys, space, page up/down, home/end */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                const map = {
                    'ArrowDown': 1, 'ArrowRight': 1, ' ': 1, 'PageDown': 1,
                    'ArrowUp': -1, 'ArrowLeft': -1, 'PageUp': -1,
                };
                if (e.key in map) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + map[e.key]);
                } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0);
                } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.totalSlides - 1);
                }
            });
        }

        /* Touch/swipe support */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (delta > 0 ? 1 : -1));
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* Mouse wheel — debounced to prevent rapid firing */
        setupWheelNav() {
            let timeout = null;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (timeout) return;
                this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                timeout = setTimeout(() => { timeout = null; }, 700);
            }, { passive: false });
        }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Mark first slide visible immediately */

def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"

    try:
        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
        script_file.write_text(script)

        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["node", str(script_file)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=180,
            env=env,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")

        server.shutdown()

    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
    if not pngs:
        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
    return pngs

def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"

    try:
        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
        script_file.write_text(script)

        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["node", str(script_file)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=180,
            env=env,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
    finally:
        server.shutdown()

    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
    if not pngs:
        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
    return pngs
